messages:
toni: hitting a parity + retry UX issue between node and python sampleapps when calling embeddings/rerank. node batch helper sometimes produces a short final vector -> server responds with 400 vector-length-mismatch and our sampleapp retries the whole batch, causing duplicate submissions.

toni: minimal repro (node):
```js
const raw = Buffer.concat(vecs.map(v => Buffer.from(new Float32Array(v).buffer)));
const b64 = raw.toString('base64');
fetch('/v1/embeddings', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-embed-001', data: b64 }) });
```

toni: in failing run lengths logged as [4096, 4096, 4092] so third vector short. python path never hit this.

arjun: two angles: SDK-level validation (reject or pad/truncate), and sampleapp retry policy is too aggressive (treats all 4xx as retryable). structural 400s like vector-dim-mismatch should be non-retryable.

min: agreed. i'll implement a small opt-in config in js-sdk: `vectorValidation: { mode: 'strict'|'pad'|'truncate' }` where default is strict. patch will throw before sending.

arjun: also adding a change in sampleapp middleware to not retry on known non-retryable 4xx codes. will map server error code `vector_dim_mismatch` to non-retryable.

toni: temp local workaround i used was padVectors(vecs, expectedDim) which got tests passing but hides root cause. not ideal.

min: added an integration test plan: spin up tiny local embed server, run node+python sampleapps against it with both raw JSON arrays and base64 payloads, compare dims and response shapes. add fuzz cases for odd byte lengths.

ci-bot: PR opened by min: "js-sdk: add vectorValidation config; sampleapp: narrow 4xx retry rules". CI checks running.

arjun: FYI finance: retry loops can cause duplicate billing in edge cases. tagging for review. :money_with_wings:

toni: also noticed rerank responses differ: python wrapper returned objects with explicit ids, node wrapper depended on array index. we should normalize to always include id in the response wrapper to avoid ambiguity after dedupe. filed issue in sdk repo.

min: will include response-shape normalization in the integration tests.

arjun: thanks — once the PR lands we'll roll a sampleapp patch and add CI integration tests to prevent regressions. keep this thread posted with any repro gists. :rocket:
